paragraphs.text: Strongrock is a small fortress at the base of Koskun Keep , on Ulgrotha . It is here that merchants are escorted by bandits loyal to Eron the Relentless .

When they descend out of hiding onto a passing caravan, they will subdue anyone who will offer resistance, inspect the goods, take their nominal percentage, then warmly escort the merchants to Strongrock.
The thieves Chandler and Joven are known to hang out here, much to Eron's chagrin.
